newsitem.title: CHINA: 1.8 million HK people sang to mark handover.
newsitem.headline: 1.8 million HK people sang to mark handover.

text.p: More than 1.8 million people in Hong Kong sang together in what was dubbed the world largest's outdoor karaoke session to mark the first day of Chinese rule earlier this week, organisers said on Friday.

The Better Hong Kong Foundation, a pro-China billionaire businessmen's club, said pollsters AC Nielsen SRH found some 1.8 million of the territory's 6.4 million people took part in the eight-minute handover singsong.

The HK$100 million ($13 million) handover spectacular included a laser and firework display and illuminated barges to celebrate Hong Kong's return to Chinese rule after 156 years of British colonial rule.
